name: Eco
description: Eco dedicated server: build a civilisation together, with laws, an economy and an ecosystem that reacts to everything players do. Automatic updates, an RCON console and world backups.

ports.name: game
ports.description: Game port; players join with host:port

ports.name: web
ports.description: Web server: the world map, stats and economy pages players open in-game

variables.label: Server token
variables.description: From play.eco → Account → Server Authentication → Generate Token (needs a Steam account that owns Eco). Without one the server starts in offline mode: not authenticated with Strange Cloud and not listed.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Shown in the server browser. Eco's text markup (colours, bold) is allowed.

variables.label: Description
variables.description: The long description players see when they select the server.

variables.label: Server password
variables.description: Leave blank for an open server. Whitelisted players never need it.

variables.label: Skip the update on start
variables.description: Start faster with the installed server instead of checking Steam for an update.

variables.label: Verify game files on start
variables.description: Have SteamCMD check every installed file. Slow; turn it on to repair a broken install.

notes:
Runs on the [DeployKit Eco image](https://github.com/deploykithq/deploykit-game-images/tree/master/images/eco). The first start downloads the server from Steam (~500 MB) and generates the world, which takes a few minutes; later starts only download updates.

- **Get a server token** at [play.eco](https://play.eco/account) → Server Authentication. Without one the server runs offline: it is not authenticated with Strange Cloud and cannot be listed.
- Players join with **host:game-port**. Publish the web port too: the in-game map and the economy and stats pages are served from it.
- Make yourself admin in `Configs/Users.eco` (the `Admins` list takes your SLG or Steam id), then restart.
- Every other setting lives in `Configs/*.eco`. A file you have not changed yet only exists as `*.eco.template`: copy it to `*.eco` and edit that. The name, description, password, listing and ports in `Network.eco` are rewritten from this page on every start.
- The console sends Eco's chat commands without the slash, over RCON inside the container: `manage players`, `manage announce Hello`.
- Backups cover `Storage/` (the world, including Eco's own backups), `Configs/` and `Mods/UserCode/`.
